column2: SOMEBODY'S BEEN DOING SAY, YOU WANT ME TO CLENCH ANYTHING, OR..? THIS... IS FOR THE FOURTH GRADE. "WHAT DO I MEAN"? I MEAN UNDERPANTS, MISTER. THAT'S WHAT I MEAN. WHAT? WHAT DO YOU MEAN? MY SKIRT! YOU LIFTED, KIDS LAUGHING. I WAS "SUSIE UNDERPANTS" TILL I WAS 18. THAT WAS IN THE FOURTH GRADE! HOW CAN YOU STILL BE UPSET ABOUT THAT? WELL, UM... WHY DON'T YOU CALL ME IN 20 YEARS AND TELL ME IF YOU'RE STILL UPSET ABOUT THIS.

HOLD ON. I'LL GET THE PLUNGER. AND TELL HIM WHAT? CALLED "THE RENT STABILIZATION ACT OF 1968." I HAVE ACTUALLY NOT HEARD OF THAT. YEAH? WELL, YOUR FRIENDS ARE IN VIOLATION OF IT. WHY DON'T YOU TELL ME SOMETHING I DON'T KNOW?
